paper_level_summary_zh: 该引用论文将目标参考文献[23]作为ADNS-3050光学鼠标传感器的数据手册进行引用，用于说明光学鼠标的像素抓取器寄存器和相关技术细节，属于技术参考，未涉及目标论文的亚毫米级感知或穿墙窃听能力。

evidences.evidence_quote: Upon reviewing technical datasheets, we made an unexpected discovery: mainstream optical sensors used in optical mice, such as the ADNS-3050 [23], include a special register called the 'pixel grabber'.
evidences.evidence_context: Upon reviewing technical datasheets, we made an unexpected discovery: mainstream optical sensors used in optical mice, such as the ADNS-3050 [23], include a special register called the 'pixel grabber'. Originally intended for debugging or testing, this register captures and retains the value of a single pixel from each image frame captured by the sensor.
evidences.reference_entry: A. Technologies, "Adns-3050 optical mouse sensor datasheet," https://www.mouser.com/datasheet/2/678/avagotechnologies ADNS-3050-1217285.pdf.
evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 引用正文中的[23]指向的是ADNS-3050光学鼠标传感器的数据手册，而非目标论文'Thru-the-wall Eavesdropping on Loudspeakers via RFID by Capturing Sub-mm Level Vibration'。目标参考文献条目是数据手册，与目标论文无关，因此为误报。 原文证据句引用了其他编号，没有引用目标论文编号。
evidences.copy_ready_zh: 未发现引用论文对目标RFID亚毫米窃听论文的有效引用或评价。
